questions.question: Is Pharmacology by Dr. GRG designed for NEET PG, INI-CET, and FMGE?
answer: Yes! Pharmacology by Dr. GRG offers focused preparation options for NEET PG | INI-CET and FMGE, with learning and practice resources designed to support your preparation for these examinations.

questions.question: Are the video lectures available in English and Hinglish?
answer: Yes! Pharmacology by Dr. GRG offers language options in English and Hinglish, allowing you to learn in the language you are most comfortable with.

questions.question: Are there separate lectures for FMGE aspirants?
answer: Yes! The app offers a separate FMGE preparation option, with relevant learning resources tailored to FMGE aspirants.

questions.question: Can I use Pharmacology by Dr. GRG if I am starting from scratch?
answer: Yes! Pharmacology by Dr. GRG supports you at different stages of preparation, even if you are starting from scratch. Begin with the GRG Master Class to build your concepts from the ground up, use Power Pack Revision and The GRG Express for revision, and strengthen your preparation with the Master Class Q.Bank and GOGA Test Approach for practice and assessment.

questions.question: Is Pharmacology by Dr. GRG enough to help me understand and revise Pharmacology?
answer: Pharmacology by Dr. GRG brings learning and revision together on one platform. Start with the GRG Master Class to understand concepts, strengthen them with Power Pack Revision, and use The GRG Express for quick revision. The Master Class Q.Bank and GOGA Test Approach help you practise MCQs and assess your preparation for NEET PG, INI-CET, and FMGE.

questions.question: Is the content updated?
answer: The app brings together learning, revision, MCQ practice, and test-based assessment to support your exam preparation. Please refer to the app and official announcements for updates to content and learning resources.

questions.question: What content is available in the Pharmacology by Dr. GRG app?
answer: The app includes five focused learning and practice resources:
•	The GRG Master Class: Detailed video lectures to build strong concepts.
•	Power Pack Revision: Quick, conceptual, high-yield revision.
•	The GRG Express: Focused revision to help you revise fast and remember more.
•	Master Class Q.Bank: Concept-based MCQs and PYQs for practice.
•	GOGA Test Approach: Attempt tests, analyse your performance, and improve.

questions.question: Are notes included with the Pharmacology by Dr. GRG plan?
answer: The app offers two types of In App notes:
•	Unannotated Notes
•	Annotated Notes

questions.question: Are tests and Q.Bank questions included?
answer: Yes. Yes Tests and Question Bank (Q.Bank) questions are included in the plan

questions.question: Are hardcopy books available?
answer: Yes! Hardcopy books will be available separately for NEET PG | INI-CET and FMGE. Please visit the Books page on our website for details.

questions.question: Are notes and question practice included in the app?
answer: Yes! The app offers learning through In App notes, MCQ practice through the Master Class Q.Bank, and test-based assessment through the GOGA Test Approach. Access to specific resources may depend on your selected plan.

questions.question: How long do I get access to the app?
answer: Subscription validity depends on the plan you purchase. Please check the Plans section on the website for the available durations and validity details.

questions.question: Do all plans include the same features?
answer: All plans provide access to the app's learning resources. Please review the inclusions of your selected plan to confirm which features are available.

questions.question: What is the minimum plan duration?
answer: The minimum available plan duration is three months.

questions.question: Can I purchase another plan before my current plan expires?
answer: Yes! You can purchase a new plan before your current plan expires. The new plan will begin after your existing plan ends.

questions.question: Are discounts available on Pharmacology by Dr. GRG plans?
answer: Yes! Special pre-booking discounts are available for a limited period. Pre-booking begins on 11 October 2026 at 12:00 PM and ends on 21 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Book during this period to avail the special pre-booking prices.

questions.question: Can I transfer my plan to another person?
answer: No. A Pharmacology by Dr. GRG subscription is personal and cannot be transferred, shared, or resold. Account sharing and unauthorised access are not permitted. Unusual login activity may result in account verification or access restrictions.

questions.question: Can I cancel my plan or request a refund?
answer: As per the Pharmacology by Dr. GRG policy, plan cancellations and refunds are not allowed.

questions.question: How do I check plan prices and inclusions?
answer: Visit the Plans section on the Pharmacology by Dr. GRG website to review subscription prices, validity, and plan inclusions before purchasing.

questions.question: Can I use the app on multiple devices?
answer: Yes! You can access the Pharmacology by Dr. GRG app on up to two devices, but you can use it on only one device at a time.

questions.question: How can I contact the Support Team?
answer: You can contact our Support Team through any of the following channels:
